title: DEV-1509 — the 16 production brands left with zero subcategories
subtitle: Approved production brands whose subcategories array is empty after the DEV-1506 vocabulary close, the DEV-1507 crafts retirement, and the DEV-1531 cutover. They are absent from every L2 page and every ?sub= facet until re-enriched. All 16 sit on home / stationery / bags-accessories, which are all eligibility: launch, so no prioritisation triage applies — the whole cohort is visible surface. Runs the full request_brand_refresh -> curation job -> apply_brand_refresh flow.
warning: This cohort targets PRODUCTION (xkcayngbttpxyibgzern). Both .env.local and .env.staging point at staging, so the default --env-file will silently refresh the wrong project and find none of these slugs. Pass a production env file explicitly. Membership was verified by live census on 2026-08-22 and supersedes docs/reports/2026-08-20-dev1509-thin-brands.csv, which is stale: 6 of its 20 rows are no longer empty and 2 empty brands are missing from it.
